title: Read part of a document
summary: Retrieve metadata, a section, or search results without reading the whole body.
purpose: Retrieve metadata, a section, or search results without reading the whole body.
request: {{route:document.meta}}, {{route:document.outline}}, {{route:document.section}}, or {{route:document.relations}}. Take `section_id` from the outline. For body search, send `q` to {{route:search.content}}. Use `doc_id` or `group_id` to restrict the search to one conversation or flow.
response: Search of one migrated CH returns compact turn matches by default. Set `include_matches=true` for locations and reuse `next_cursor` with the same search conditions.
errors: On `400` from a malformed cursor or changed conditions, restart the search. Supply only one of `doc_id` and `group_id`.
